description:
Get user's lending position on Zest Protocol (v0-4-market).

Returns collateral, debt, health factor, and LTV data across all assets.
The position query returns USD-denominated totals.

Note: Zest Protocol is only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: User address (uses wallet if not specified)

asset.description: Asset symbol (e.g., 'sBTC', 'USDC') or full contract ID

name: zest_get_position
